title: Migrate endpoint retry semantics to a transport-injected retry wrapper
target_requirement: Deliver migrated.py exporting TransientError/PermanentError and call_with_retry(endpoint_cfg, transport) -> result dict: at most retry+1 transport attempts where only transient errors are retried, permanent errors stop immediately, url/timeout_ms are passed to the injected transport on every attempt, and the outcome dict {ok, attempts, result, error} replaces raised exceptions.
expected_behavior: With endpoints.ini values: erp_orders (retry=3) makes exactly 4 attempts on persistent transient failure and stops early on success; notifier (retry=0) makes exactly 1 attempt; a permanent error yields attempts==1 (or stops a retry sequence where it occurs) with error type 'permanent' and message str(exception); no exception propagates; failure results carry result=None.
provenance: Synthetic; authored for LegacyCRM-Bench from Meridian CRM 4.2 spec (SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md §6, §7).
security_expectations: No real network access: the transport is injected and the module must not import network modules; permanent failures must never be retried (retry storms against a rejecting endpoint are a failure).
failure_conditions: Off-by-one attempt counts (retry instead of retry+1); retrying permanent errors; letting transport exceptions escape; sleeping/backoff timing; nondeterminism; network access.
